events.event: The Constitutional Court (MK) holds a further hearing on a judicial review of the Elucidation of Article 603 KUHP (state-loss element), after KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo said on 22 Oct that state-loss calculation should not be limited to BPK.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 26 Oct 2026 · Article 603 KUHP · Article 23E(1) UUD 1945 · MK Decision 31/PUU-X/2012 · petitioner retired Rear Adm. Leonardi (Perkara 206/PUU-XXIV/2026, per Hukumonline)
events.why_it_matters: Who may declare 'kerugian negara' decides how corruption cases are proven, on top of the Luhut proposal to drop state loss from the definition.

events.event: Komisi IV DPR deputy chair Alex Indra Lukman says the Forestry Bill (RUU Kehutanan) can include prosecuting forest burning as 'terorisme ekologi', following Prabowo's call to study that classification.
events.key_numbers: Revision of UU 41 (Forestry) finished at Komisi IV and harmonised at Baleg · next step: presidential letter (Surpres) · Prabowo instruction made 16 Sep 2026 limited meeting
events.why_it_matters: Haze-hit Indonesians may see harsher penalties for burners, but Walhi warns the label could criminalise small farmers.

events.event: Prosecutors demand 10 years' prison, a Rp500 million fine and dismissal from the military for Letjen TNI Widi Prasetijono, a former aide to Jokowi, in a Cilacap state-land sale (Caruy plantation) corruption trial at the Military High Court II Jakarta; this is a demand, not a verdict.
events.key_numbers: Alleged state loss Rp237.09 billion · 716.2 hectares · restitution Rp21.05 billion · fine Rp500 juta · demand 10 years
events.why_it_matters: A sitting-rank general tried over state-land sale, showing the state-loss element being used in a live case.
